title: Associate Project Manager (NP)
Job Summary: Reasons you will want this position:  We are a rapidly growing company with limitless career growth and advancement for top performersOur culture appreciates and rewards creative ideas, especially those that achieve better outcomes for everyoneWork with a team of talented technology professionals who will challenge and help you perform at your best  Summary Cedar Gate Technologies is looking for an Associate Project Manager to lead and manage client-facing software development projects from initiation through delivery. This role is responsible for planning and coordinating project activities, managing cross-functional teams, identifying and mitigating risks, and ensuring projects are delivered on time. The ideal candidate will be organized, eager to learn, and possesses strong communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills, with an interest in building a career in software project management within a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
roles: Assist in developing and executing project and sprint plans to support timely and high‑quality deliveryFacilitate Scrum ceremonies to ensure meetings are focused and productiveSupport the identification and removal of impediments to maintain a smooth and continuous delivery flowManage stakeholder expectations by providing timely status updates, aligning on priorities, and escalting scope or timeline concerns when needed Proactively collaborate with stakeholders in Nepal and the US to resolve blockers and work closely with Product Owners to help refine and prioritize the backlogCoordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth end-to-end project executionPrepare project status reports and support the development of mitigation and contingency plansTrack and maintain performance metrics to help measure team efficiency and sprint progessSupport team communicaton and help address conflicts or collaboration challenges as they ariseContribute to the continuous improvement of project practices by implementing learning and best practices across projects
qualifications: 2+ years of experience in the software industry in project coordination, project management, or related role Strong analytical, time-management, and problem-solving skillsExcellent written and verbal communication abilitiesAbility to work collaboratively with cross-functional teamsFlexible to support project needs, including occasional non-standard working hours Hands-on experience with JIRA reporting and Confluence documentation would be highly desirable Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies; Scrum Master training or certification is a plusFamiliarity with US Healthcare data, systems, or domain processes is an advantage
environment: If you join Cedar Gate, you can make great ideas happen for some of the world's most dynamic companies. With broad global resources and deep technical know-how, we collaborate with clients to cultivate ideas and deliver results in the medical industry. Choose a career at Cedar Gate and enjoy an innovative environment where challenging and interesting work is part of daily life.  Next to our excellent terms of employment and fringe benefits, we invest considerable resources to provide ongoing training that builds and extends professional, technical, and management skills in all areas. At Cedar Gate, you will operate in a professional environment where teamwork and innovation are immensely encouraged. Together with colleagues, you will work on high-impact projects for many dynamic companies.
about: Cedar Gate enables payers, providers, employers, and service administrators to excel at value-based care. Our unified technology and services platform enhances and automates data management activities to deliver employer and provider analytics, care management, and payment technology necessary to pursue every payment model and optimize performance in all lines of business. From primary care attribution to bundled payments to capitation, our platform is designed to improve clinical, financial, and operational outcomes for all.    Cedar Gate Services Pvt. Ltd, Nepal, provides software research & development, data analytics, IT infrastructure management and various support services for Cedar Gate Technologies, USA. We employ 750+ professionals in our Sanepa office. For more information, visit company website at https://cedargate.com/ and follow our FB page at https://www.facebook.com/CGTNepal.
